This file documents declared operations at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =objects=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =put-objects=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 7F4DD689-6D29-5A00-BE1F-0D5D847BDCB7
:END:

Sends =put_objects_request= and prints =put_objects_response=, so the shape is the protocol's and the meaning is the service's. It reads =bucket=, =key=, =content=, =content_encoding=, in that order. The caller must have established a session first.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
objects put-objects <bucket> <key> <content> <content_encoding>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =storage.v1.objects.put=.
